basic_profile.bio: Avid truth-seeker and long-time Redditor. I grew up in the Midwest, surrounded by vast fields and open skies, which fueled my curiosity about the world. I work as a civil engineer, often pondering the societal structures we build both physically and metaphorically. In my free time, I dive deep into conspiracy theories and alternative narratives, always questioning the status quo. I am currently single and enjoy spending quiet evenings with my cat, Luna. My online activity peaks between 8 PM and midnight, after a long day at work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is a mix of formal education in engineering and self-taught insights into conspiracy theories, sociology, and philosophy. I have a bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering and have spent countless hours reading articles, watching documentaries, and engaging in discussions online.
